stem: Priya keeps a potted tulsi plant on her sunny balcony in Jaipur. Her teacher asks her to complete the word equation for photosynthesis. Which statement completes it correctly?

options.text: Glucose and oxygen, in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll, are changed into carbon dioxide and water.
Carbon dioxide and water, in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll, are changed into glucose and oxygen.
Carbon dioxide and water are changed into glucose and oxygen even when the plant is kept in a dark room.
Oxygen and water, in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll, are changed into glucose and carbon dioxide.

teacher.key_rationale: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll to produce glucose and oxygen, so B is correct. A reverses the relationship, C omits the light condition, and D substitutes the wrong gases on each side.
